ci_mode.description: Orchestration target. 'local' for standard development, 'github' for cloud verification stage.

loop_mode.description: If true, the orchestrator automatically processes the next task after success. If false, it stops after one task.

loop_delay_seconds.description: Delay in seconds between tasks when loop_mode is active to avoid API rate limits (e.g., HTTP 429 on Groq).

max_task_attempts.description: Master Circuit Breaker: Maximum retries for a single task across all workflow stages before HALT.

max_continuous_tasks.description: Safety cap: Maximum number of different tasks processed in a single loop run.

active.description: Diagnostic & strategic phase before planning. Recommended for complex goals.

pause_after.description: If true, stops the pipeline after analysis for operator review. If false, continues to PLANNING.

active.description: Queen decomposes goals into atomic technical tasks in [AGENT_PROGRESS].
Developer implements code and tests. This is the main construction phase.
Pedant and automated scripts verify PEP8 and Type compliance.
Developer executes the test suite to ensure logical correctness.
Auditor performs final security and quality verification before completion.
Automatically push the verified branch to origin (v2 Cloud Stage).
Automatically open a Pull Request using GitHub CLI (v2 Cloud Stage).
Wait and poll for GitHub Actions result in the cloud (v2 Cloud Stage).

smart_fallback.description: If the primary API provider fails, automatically attempt fallback using the matrix.

GROQ.description: If Groq (Developer/Pedant) fails or rate-limits, redirect to Mistral large model.

MISTRAL.description: If Mistral (Queen/Auditor) fails, fallback to Groq using the robust Llama 70b.

yellow_zone_threshold.description: Context window usage percentage that triggers context-compressor skill.

red_zone_threshold.description: Context window usage percentage that triggers emergency HALT.

show_task_id.description: Include [TASK-XXX] prefix in every log line for better traceability.

verbosity.description: Terminal output detail level (DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR).
